_help: Add or remove beaches here. surfline_spot_id comes from the Surfline URL: surfline.com/surf-report/<name>/<SPOT_ID>. lat/lon are used for the Open-Meteo fallback and the rain check. offshore_dir is the compass direction (degrees) an OFFSHORE wind blows FROM at this beach (~NE for most LA westside beaches). noaa_station is the NOAA tide station used for the fallback tide (9410840 = Santa Monica Pier). exposure scales the fallback wave estimate for spots sheltered from open-ocean swell (Santa Monica Bay ~0.75; open coast 1.0) - tune by comparing against Surfline's site. tz is the beach's IANA timezone (default America/Los_Angeles).
